slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

the honest answer

next time someone asks how you are, answer honestly in one sentence. people connect with truth, not with "good, you?", and saying it out loud makes you less afraid of being seen.

solo day trips

take a day trip alone to a town you've never visited, once a season. figuring things out with nobody to lean on proves to you that you can handle the unknown.

one minute talks

record yourself giving a 1 minute talk on any topic, every day for 2 weeks, and watch them back. the cringe fades by day 5, and what's left is a voice you actually trust.

a moment a day

every evening, take 5 minutes to learn about one moment in history or one famous artwork. knowing a little about a lot means you never feel out of place, whoever you're talking to.
slides.texte_sophia:
a moment a day

every evening, take 5 minutes to learn about one moment in history or one famous artwork. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy, and you'll never feel out of place in a conversation.

slides.texte_overlay:
offline evenings

spend one evening a week fully offline and tell nobody. the world keeps turning without your replies, and that's strangely freeing for anyone who always tries to please.
